name: project
description: A small folder of structured markdown for a project and the skills that keep it true for PMs, designers, developers and clients: new (scaffold, interview, fill, resume), add (file a prompt, document or transcript into the right files as one change record), decide (record, supersede, accept a decision), status (where the project stands, what waits on whom, what has drifted), report (for the client, the PM or the tech team, over a period) and any project skill added to project/ later
